text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Incident detected — elevated 5xx and p95 latency for Hosted API and Dedicated pools in eu-west-1. Source: metrics-proxy (third-party) returning 502s to our observability ingestion. See incident dashboard: https://console.redwood/incident/5432109876
jess: paging @ryan oncall — I'm seeing gateway 502/504 spikes and downstream kv cache timeouts, customers getting retries. Can you take?
ryan: on it, grabbing logs. Initial correlation shows metrics-proxy errors start ~09:12 UTC, aligns with spike. Will try emergency routing and a temporary backpressure on observability writes.
ryan: quick check: `curl -sS https://prod-metrics-proxy.eu-west-1/health | jq .` returns 502 and timeout.
priya: heads-up — runtime fallback only protects internal telemetry, not token validation path. metrics-proxy sits in path for token validation for eu-west-1, which explains auth latencies bubbling up.
dan: I'll prepare an override in routing-control-plane to bypass metrics proxy for auth and token endpoints in eu-west-1. Patch: `PATCH /v1/routes/override` body `{"region":"eu-west-1","skip_metrics_proxy":true}`
ryan: handing to night oncall @alex for mitigation and monitoring — alex can you take now?
alex: I'm awake, taking over. Confirming I will apply dan's route override and watch traffic.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: Alert escalated to SRE -> alex
alex: applied routing override at 09:45 UTC, switching token validation to local cache. Observing p50/p95 and 5xx.
alex: quick numbers: p50 for API down from 280ms -> 120ms within 2m after override. 5xx rate dropping but still intermittent.
laura: CS: customers on Dedicated pools 1234 and 5678 reported timeouts. Preparing status banner. ETA for message?
jess: short banner please: "We are investigating increased latency and errors in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress" + link to status page.
laura: posted banner and opened CS tickets for top impacted customers.
ryan: recommend throttling observability writes to the third-party in eu-west-1 to reduce load: set `OBS_INGEST_RATE=0.2` on obs-proxy. Priya can you enact?
priya: setting env var via k8s for obs-proxy-deploy in infra-eu-west-1:
```
kubectl set env deploy/obs-proxy OBS_INGEST_RATE=0.2 -n infra-eu-west-1
```
priya: rollout started, pod restarts 2/3 so far, monitoring readiness and error rates.
alex: 10m after rate cap + routing override: 5xxs reduced ~75%. p95 trending down. Keeping override for monitoring window.
dan: regional Dedicated pool migration is higher risk; we'll avoid migrating now. Continue with routing override + rate caps.
laura: mapping impacted customers and notifying account teams. No confirmed SLA breach yet; a couple of retries observed for large-volume customers.
jess: action items: (1) alex monitor for 60m, (2) priya keep rate cap until stable, (3) dan prepare revert playbook for routing override, (4) laura continue customer comms.
alex: acknowledged, will update every 15m or on status change.
IncidentBot: Incident update posted to #incidents at 10:30 UTC.
ryan: postmortem owners: @ryan + @priya + @dan. Tentative priority: P1 postmortem (H1).
laura: will draft initial customer-facing summary after we declare incident closed.
alex: marking mitigation stable at 10:01 UTC — p95 back within normal thresholds, traffic healthy. Moving to monitoring phase. :white_check_mark:
jess: thanks team — great coordination. Closing pager for now, please keep watch for 2 hours. :thumbsup:
